rubric_source: outputs/PurdueBlender/AGENT.md; five criteria, 2 points each, minimum pass 8/10

photo.caption: Harrison Hall exterior (official page hero image); no capture date or compass direction provided.
photo.registration: No camera pose/compass direction is published. Compared visible motifs only; did not use it for orientation, placement, length, width, height, or measurements.

photo_cue_review.cue: Red-brown brick on tall wings and lower connector
photo_cue_review.visual_match: Supported at broad color/material level; model texture is stylized and no sample-based color measurement was made.
photo_cue_review.not_verified: Exact brick hue, course size, mortar, and facade coverage on unseen elevations.

photo_cue_review.cue: Repeated narrow windows stacked vertically on a tall wing
photo_cue_review.visual_match: Repeated vertical window bands are visible in both photo and render.
photo_cue_review.not_verified: Exact width, spacing, count correspondence to the pictured wing, frame profile, or compass orientation.

photo_cue_review.cue: Light perforated screen across lower connector
photo_cue_review.visual_match: A light lattice/perforated screen spans a low connector region in both images.
photo_cue_review.not_verified: Exact screen dimensions, lattice module, material, construction, and claimed solar-control function.

photo_cue_review.cue: Glazed entrance adjoining broad light canopy/overhang
photo_cue_review.visual_match: Glazing at the entry and a broad light-colored horizontal canopy/overhang are visible in both images.
photo_cue_review.not_verified: Canopy projection/height, exact entrance proportions, or registered faÃ§ade alignment.

photo_cue_review.cue: HARRISON HALL lettering/model sign and rooftop equipment
photo_cue_review.visual_match: Not confirmed by this photograph; no score awarded for the sign, rooftop equipment, or other unpictured details.
